label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McIlroy on Track 2
items.text: Rory McIlroy criticized the PGA Tour's planned Track 2 events as "a glorified Korn Ferry event," warning top tournaments like the Canadian Open could lose stature without $30 million sponsorships.

items.headline: Koepka's Fresh Start
items.text: Brooks Koepka left LIV Golf's final year to return to the PGA Tour, seeking a sixth major and citing family reasons, including marriage and recent loss, as motivation.

items.headline: Fitzpatrick's New Driver
items.text: Matt Fitzpatrick believes he found a suitable new driver after his old one cracked and is focusing on improving his putting stroke flow ahead of play at Shinnecock Hills.
